title: Turang, Geser Dulu
mood: riang, menggoda, bergoyang (cheerful, teasing, made for dancing)
subject: At a Kabanjahe kerja tahun, a Karo boy and his cousin turang, who by custom must open the landek together, plot to swap partners so each can dance with the person he or she actually likes.
caption: Karo gendang keyboard dance-pop in a patam-patam party groove. Arranger keyboard playing a sampled gendang-and-gung patam-patam dance groove, kulcapi two-string lute in quick plucked riffs, sarune shawm lead lines between verses, keteng-keteng bamboo percussion ostinato, bouncing two-note electric bass. bright live party-band mix, wide keyboard groove, tight percussion. Male lead, mid-high tenor with Karo-style ornaments at phrase ends, clearly sung, female harmony on the chorus. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 126 BPM, A minor. Cheerful, teasing, made for dancing. No rap, no autotune, no trap hi-hats, no heavy distorted guitar, no orchestral strings.
lyrics:
[Intro - keyboard patam-patam groove and sarune]
[Verse 1]
Kerja tahun di Kabanjahe, ramai kali
Gendang keyboard bunyi sampai ke ujung kampung
Landek pertama harus sama turangku
Aturan adat, tak bisa kutolak
[Pre-Chorus]
Padahal mataku ke gadis berbaju merah
Dan matanya ke abang yang di sebelah
[Chorus]
Turang, geser dulu, geser dulu
Biar kutukar tempat sama dia
Turang, geser dulu, cemana lagi
Sama-sama kita yang punya rahasia
[Verse 2]
Kuikuti langkah, kaki ke kiri, ke kanan
Turangku bisik, tenang, aku atur
Dia lirik abang itu, aku lirik si merah
Pura-pura salah langkah, kita pindah
[Pre-Chorus]
Satu, dua, tiga, tukar!
Tangan berganti, senyum pun berganti
[Chorus]
Turang, geser dulu, geser dulu
Sudah pas sekarang tempat kita
Turang, geser dulu, cemana lagi
Mejuah-juah, semua orang tertawa
[Chorus]
Turang, geser dulu, geser dulu
Besok kita cerita sama-sama
Turang, geser dulu, cemana lagi
Landek ini kita yang atur
[Outro - keyboard groove and sarune]
Mejuah-juah, mejuah-juah
